checkpoint: Students can distinguish the local starter from a deployed service.
referenceExamplesTested: actual SDK state serialization round trip
serviceAdaptersStillRequired: deployment secrets, TLS, logging, backups and retention

authenticationContract.requestId: Mint on admission; persist original value through decisions and resume.

store: owner tenant, actor, session and conversation
exact interruption call ID, tool and arguments
encrypted SDK RunState and encryption key reference
durableStateContract.protection: Use authenticated encryption with identity/proposal metadata as associated data; restrict access, bound payload size, redact secrets and apply retention. Never deserialize browser-supplied SDK state.
durableStateContract.restore: Reconstruct the same agent/tool recipe, decrypt trusted storage, restore SDK RunState, and verify the exact pending item before applying its stored decision.

workerRecovery.decision: Fresh authorization plus revision CAS; decision and outbox commit atomically.
workerRecovery.claim: One lease and fencing token per job; revalidate current membership, session, recipe and expiry before execution.
workerRecovery.authorizationRace: Define and implement transaction-time authorization/revocation semantics; the existing repository role flag alone does not reload current membership.
workerRecovery.resume: Apply approve/reject to the exact restored interruption and preserve original request context.
workerRecovery.crashAfterCommit: Reconcile operation receipts and audit evidence before redelivery; a queue lease alone does not prevent duplicate effects.
workerRecovery.unknownOutcome: Persist unknown status and investigate; deadline or cancellation does not undo a prior commit.

operationalLimits.existing: 8 turns per Runner invocation, 8 approval rounds, 4000 input characters, 120 history items; pool max 5 with bounded SQL timeouts.
operationalLimits.serverDesign: Atomic shared admission for rate, tenant concurrency, queue size and token/cost budgets. Add cumulative model-call budgets across resumes, deadlines, cancellation and state-size limits.
operationalLimits.capacity: Proposed numeric values are teaching examples. Size per-worker pools and aggregate service concurrency against measured database/provider capacity.

realPostgresTestsExecuted: runtime grants reject DDL, physical deletion and audit reads
two stale-version competitors yield one commit and one conflict
concurrent exact replay yields one stored mutation
audit failure rolls back and releases reusable clients
repository tenant scope and archived evidence
competing approval decisions yield one decision and outbox row
deploymentIntegrationTestsStillRequired: real token verification, expiry, revocation and CSRF
membership revocation before resume and authorization race semantics
encrypted storage tamper rejection and key rotation
multi-worker lease expiry, stale fencing and restart recovery
crash after mutation commit before job completion
distributed quota exhaustion and cancellation after commit
actual TLS, deployed secrets and deployed database grants
RLS policies if enabled; no RLS is configured in the starter
releaseGate: Keep each unimplemented adapter and unrun integration test visible. A passing local suite is not evidence of a deployed authenticated service.
